purpose: Post-study negative controls for testing whether the local 3% quality-retention gate detects known official behavior failures near leaderboard ranks 112-126.

selection.policy: Use completed official token/correctness failures with recorded candidate commits; prefer distinct mechanisms and exclude performance-only rejection, static-review failure, worker-crash, and no-score outcomes.
selection.relationship_to_primary_study: Separate diagnostic set. These controls must not be added to candidates.json or counted among the 15 required promoted submissions.

local_source_object_check.verification: Each source_ref resolves exactly to a local Git commit object; commit, tree, parent, and validation-subject identities were read from the object database.
local_source_object_check.workspace_availability: The control workspace is a shared clone of this repository and can resolve these verified objects without changing the primary study workspace.

local_evaluation_contract.public_probe: Exact first token after the 512-token public prompt.

interpretation.local_pass: Discordant false pass relative to the official exact-behavior label. This is evidence that the local gate is incomplete or hardware/path-misaligned as a submission-safety surrogate; it is not by itself proof that the numeric 3% semantic-quality threshold is too loose.
interpretation.local_regression: Concordant true negative relative to the official outcome. Attribute the detection to the specific failing local component rather than treating exit 3 alone as a mechanism diagnosis.
interpretation.invalid_or_noncomplete: No quality-gate inference. Preserve the attempt as infrastructure or runtime evidence and do not count it as a detected regression.
interpretation.global_caveat: The local suite runs on M4 and checks downstream quality plus only the public prompt's first token. The official M5 contract checks a 64-step public trajectory and private exact-token, free-run, GPQA, and semantic behavior.

controls.label: public-token-mismatch-native-affine-tail
controls.mechanism: Changed the default native affine NVFP4 attention-tail boundary from layer 24 to layer 16, moving layers 16-23 from the affine INT8 side representation back to shipped group-16 NVFP4.
controls.control_role: Highest-priority public-behavior negative. It directly tests whether the local first-token probe or downstream/PPL checks detect a submission that diverged on the official public trajectory.

expected_interpretation.local_pass: Coverage or transfer false pass: the official public mismatch was missed locally.
expected_interpretation.local_regression: Desired detection of a known public-behavior failure. Record whether the exact probe, downstream score, PPL, or ranked GPQA caused the failure.

controls.independence_caveat: Mechanistically distinct from the split-K and router/shared-prefill controls. The official mismatch may occur after the first generated token or only under M5 numerical behavior, so a local pass cannot isolate threshold looseness from probe-depth or hardware mismatch.

controls.label: hidden-correctness-small-m-split-k

official.failure_step: Correctness and gates (full base case + hidden gates, no timing)

controls.mechanism: Bound the NVFP4 quantized-matmul split-K arm to small-M shapes, changing split-K dispatch selection in the prefill kernel path.
controls.control_role: Independent private-correctness negative with a completed official result and a passing public gate. It tests whether the semantic/PPL proxy notices a kernel-level exactness failure not exposed by the public prompt.

expected_interpretation.local_pass: The proxy preserved measured local quality despite a private exact-correctness failure; classify as official/local contract discordance, not automatically as semantic-quality loss.
expected_interpretation.local_regression: Desired discrimination against a completed hidden-correctness failure from a distinct kernel mechanism.

controls.independence_caveat: Independent in mechanism from the native-affine boundary and multi-mechanism router/shared-prefill control. Dispatch eligibility is shape- and GPU-dependent, so confirm the local quality workload actually reaches the changed split-K arm before drawing a threshold conclusion.

controls.label: hidden-correctness-native-attention-router-shared-prefill

official.failure_step: Correctness and gates (full base case + hidden gates, no timing)

controls.mechanism: Composed all-reference-NVFP4 attention, corrected router-key production, and shared-expert prefill gate/up fusion.
controls.control_role: Broader private-correctness negative that stresses composition risk across attention, routing, and shared-expert prefill rather than one isolated dispatch predicate.

expected_interpretation.local_pass: The local proxy did not detect a completed private-correctness failure in a multi-mechanism composition; report as surrogate incompleteness or architecture/path mismatch.
expected_interpretation.local_regression: Desired detection, but the aggregate control cannot identify which composed mechanism caused either the official or local failure.

controls.independence_caveat: Conceptually near-duplicates submission d8cd3e24-b97f2635, so treat the pair as one failure family rather than independent evidence. This control is independent from the split-K mechanism but overlaps the native-attention representation family of e40e4013 and may exercise different paths on M4 versus M5.
